description: The fourth binder contains an issue of El Palacio, six negatives of Pueblo women and pottery, MC notes on writings of various S.W. anthropologists, tracing of designs, a comparison of Pueblo and Chinese sexual symbols, and 35 photographs of Pueblo Bread with 10 other photographs of unknown subjects. Contains: issue of "El Palacio", negatives, notes on writings, comparison of Chinese and Pueblo symbols, tracing and photographs.
title: Pottery designs
